verdicts.reason: A breaks the product apart: the green circle is cut off on the left edge, separated from the can, which sits on its own at the far right and is clipped at the bottom. It also puts the wordmark below the headline, makes the CTA the same size as the badges, crams body copy too small to read beside them and leaves dead space on the right. B keeps the can inside its circle, reads left to right (brand, headline, copy, badges, then a prominent CTA) and has clean margins; its only flaws are small badges stacked in a slightly awkward column and a fairly small wordmark.
